summary: Adversarial audit added durable Playwright cross-browser/device coverage and found a remaining production deploy-gated accessibility regression: live prod header navigation/language controls expose visible tap targets below 32px across desktop and mobile browser profiles. A tightly scoped source fix and static guard were added locally, but the live Playwright suite cannot pass until deployment.
findings: Live production still serves header tap targets below 32px for CodeCamp, Dashboard, Chat Tutor, and sometimes EN across Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, mobile Chrome, and mobile Safari; local source fix requires deploy before Phase 11 can pass.
Authenticated module-device E2E remains skipped without PHASE11_TEST_INTERN_USERNAME and PHASE11_TEST_INTERN_PASSWORD.
